Strictly include all requested sections and elements:
1. Top compact header (already in shell or seamless integration): hamburger menu on left, BICE Data Academy / BICE LMS logo centered, search icon on right.
2. Hero section:
   - Pill badge: 'NEW COHORT ENROLLING • Q3 EXECUTIVE' with subtle pulse dot.
   - Headline: 'Master Data Skills That Drive Your Career' (scaled perfectly for mobile viewport, bold, clean Inter typography).
   - Subtext: 'Executive-caliber hands-on training in Advanced Excel, Power Query, PostgreSQL, and BI dashboards. Built for ambitious business practitioners.'
   - Two stacked full-width touch-friendly buttons: 'Explore Courses ->' (primary indigo-600 with white text) and 'Get Started Free' (white/slate-50 background with dark slate border, subtle shadow).
   - Social proof badge under CTAs: 5 gold stars '4.9/5 • 12,000+ corporate alumni'.
   - Mobile Hero Graphic/Mockup card: Dark sleek terminal / SQL & Excel executive pipeline sandbox mockup with syntax highlighting (SQL CTE query, revenue metrics, green executed badge, sparkline variance yield +24.8% YoY).
3. Stats Band:
   - 2x2 compact grid cards with subtle rounded-xl border and soft shadow:
     * Card 1: 12,000+ (Students Certified) with blue graduation cap/user icon
     * Card 2: 25+ (Specialized Courses) with purple layers/course icon
     * Card 3: 4.8 / 5.0 (Consensus Rating) with amber star icon
     * Card 4: 96% (Career Advancement / Support) with green trending growth icon
4. Categories horizontal chips row:
   - Filter chips with icons: 'All Tracks' (active indigo), 'Advanced Excel', 'Power Query & ETL', 'SQL Analytics', 'Python for Finance'. Horizontal scrolling with smooth snap.
5. Featured Courses Section:
   - Section header: 'TOP RATED PROGRAMS' uppercase tracker, 'Featured Masterclasses' title, with 'Browse all ->' text link.
   - Horizontal snap scroll carousel cards (showing courses clearly with card width ~300px):
     * Course 1: Level badge 'ADVANCED' (red badge), title 'Advanced Excel: Dynamic Arrays & Financial Modeling', lessons & duration '18.5 hrs • 42 lessons', star rating 4.9 (3,820), price '$89' (strikethrough $149).
     * Course 2: Level badge 'INTERMEDIATE' (amber badge), title 'Power Query & Automated ETL: Corporate Pipelines', duration '14 hrs • 30 lessons', rating 4.8 (1,890), price '$79' (strikethrough $129).
     * Course 3: Level badge 'BEGINNER-TO-PRO' (green badge), title 'SQL for Modern Data Analysis & Warehousing', duration '22 hrs • 56 lessons', rating 4.9 (4,150), price '$99' (strikethrough $169).
6. 'Why BICE' Benefit Cards:
   - Section label 'THE BICE DIFFERENCE', headline 'Engineered for Rapid Career Impact' with subtext 'No theoretical fluff. We teach the exact workflows required to deliver results on day one.'
   - 3 stacked benefit cards with clean icons and soft gray borders:
     * 1. 'Practitioner-Only Faculty' - Every module is crafted and delivered by practicing VP and Director-level data professionals from top technology, financial institutions, and global management consultancies.
     * 2. 'Messy Real-World Datasets' - Practice resolving mismatched fiscal calendars, uncleared CSV exports, null reconciliations, and currency fluctuation anomalies straight from enterprise audits.
     * 3. 'Verifiable Accreditation' - Earn high-trust digital credentials with immutable verification hashes easily shareable directly to LinkedIn and recognized by leading recruitment agencies.
7. Testimonial Card:
   - Section badge 'STUDENT OUTCOMES', title 'Validated by Top Performers'.
   - Testimonial card with 5 gold stars, quote: '"The Power Query automation track alone saved our department 14 hours every single Monday morning. My leadership noticed immediately, leading to a senior analyst promotion within 3 months."'
   - Reviewer: Samantha Patel (Lead Financial Analyst, Deloitte) with avatar badge and verified checkmark.
8. FAQ Accordion (3 interactive items):
   - 'Do I need prior coding experience for Python or SQL?' (Expanded with detailed practical answer).
   - 'Are the courses self-paced or tied to cohort schedules?' (Collapsed).
   - 'Can my corporate employer sponsor my enrollment?' (Collapsed).
9. Newsletter Band:
   - Sleek dark slate-900 / indigo container with tag 'Bi-weekly Executive Briefing'.
   - Headline 'Stay Ahead of the Data Curve', subtext 'Join 35,000+ analysts receiving our bi-weekly breakdown of real-world Excel tips, SQL queries, and modern analytics architectures.'
   - Email input field with placeholder 'Enter your work email address' and full-width 'Subscribe Free ->' button. Small subtext 'Zero spam • Unsubscribe anytime'.
10. Footer Accordion & Legal:
    - BICE Data Academy branding & mission statement.
    - Collapsible accordion groups: 'Courses & Curriculums', 'Student Support', 'Campus & Contact'.
    - Social icons row (LinkedIn, X / Twitter, YouTube, GitHub).
    - Copyright '© 2025 BICE Learning Management System. All rights reserved.' and privacy policy
